title: Preview process manager — spawn/stop/restart + bounded log capture + URL detection
description: BETA-TEST GOAL (goal-app-preview), part 2 of 5. A managed child-process controller for the previewed app. Starts the resolved command as a child process, captures stdout/stderr into a BOUNDED ring buffer, tracks a state machine, detects the served URL/port (from config or by scanning early logs), and stops/restarts cleanly. Single active preview at a time. Mirrors the orchestrator-bridge (src/orchestrator-bridge.js) spawn discipline. Independent of TASK-065 (tested with a hand-built config object); TASK-067 wires the two together.
acceptance_criteria: New module src/preview-process.js exports a controller (e.g. createPreviewController({repoRoot}) or start/stop/restart/getStatus) managing ONE child process launched from a resolved preview config.
State machine: stopped -> starting -> running (or -> exited/error); getStatus returns { state, mode, url (string|null), pid (number|null), recentLogs (bounded array) }.
stdout/stderr captured into a BOUNDED buffer (named cap constant on lines and/or bytes, oldest dropped, no unbounded growth); never throws on odd/binary output.
URL/port detection: use the configured url/port if present; else scan early stdout for the first localhost URL or a listening-on-PORT pattern and surface it in status.
stop() terminates the child cleanly with no orphan process; restart() = stop then start; stop() is idempotent when already stopped (no throw).

tdd: failing tests first for state-machine transitions, buffer bounding, URL detection, and idempotent stop, exercised with a trivial spawnable fixture (tiny node http server / echo loop) under tests/e2e/.
release-tier gate: npm run test:all green; rebuild + commit dist if bundled source changes.
